label.description: Language name shown in the meta row (e.g. Swahili, Urdu).

link.description: Story or URL for this language version.

languages.description: Alternate language versions of this article.

show_share.description: Show social share icons (Facebook, X, LinkedIn, copy link).

enable_horizontal_spacing.description: Applies default side padding (20px mobile / 80px desktop) and any side spacing overrides below.

enable_vertical_spacing.description: Applies default bottom margin (56px mobile / 100px desktop) and any vertical spacing overrides below.

title.description: Dark heading text (e.g. "Trusted by leading educational").

logos.description: Accreditation / brand logos shown in a single row.

highlight.description: Green portion of the title (institutes / testimonials).

background_image.description: Used by the Research Focus variant.

image.description: Side image for the secondary variant.

cta_label.description: Used when no slides are provided.

slides.description: Carousel slides for the primary variant.

image.description: Used as the slide background, or as the video poster when a video is set.

video.description: Optional. When set, plays muted and looping as the slide background (image becomes the poster).

video_url.description: Optional external/direct video URL. Used when no uploaded video asset is set.

stories.description: First story is featured; next two show as secondary cards on desktop.

content.description: Plain-text fallback content, used when no cards are added.

bg_pattern.description: Used by the image-cards layout (top triangle band).

languages.description: Alternate language versions of this article.

banner_image.description: Featured image shown below article meta.

description.description: Lead / intro content. Only RichText blocks are allowed.

body.description: Article content. Related Cards bands are added automatically — do not add related_cards here.

show_similar.description: Show the Similar News related-cards band (cards from code).

similar_show_header.description: Show title, highlight, and description on the similar band.

show_social.description: Show the Social Media related-cards band (cards from code).

social_show_header.description: Show title, highlight, and description on the social band.

highlight.description: Second, colored half of the heading.

cta_label.description: Optional button shown inside the card (overlay layout).

footer_logo.description: Optional small logo shown below the card (columns layout).

attribution.description: Gold attribution line for centered and attributed variants (e.g. "- President Name").

category.description: Centered variant meta shown after the date (e.g. "Convocation").

portrait.description: Portrait image for the attributed variant.

items.description: Row items. Each becomes a column on desktop and stacks on mobile.

width.description: Optional fixed container width in px. Blank = full width.

body.description: Any component(s) to render inside this row item.

width.description: Percent width on desktop (0-100). Blank = auto equal split (1 item 100%, 2 items 50/50, 3 items 33.33%). Widths over 100% total wrap to the next line.

default_tab.description: Must match a tab value/label. Defaults to the first tab.

pattern_image.description: Optional geometric pattern shown behind the strip on mobile.

description.description: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

highlight.description: Green portion of the title (e.g. "Students Affairs").

social_links.description: Up to 4 social links (Facebook, Instagram, Spotify, Linktree).

icon.description: Optional. Overrides the default platform icon (required for Custom).
